items.source: NOTE: The @RequestMapping annotation will only be processed if a corresponding HandlerMapping (for type-level annotations) and/or HandlerAdapter (for method-level annotations) is present in the dispatcher. This is the case by default. However, if you are defining custom HandlerMappings or HandlerAdapters, then you need to make sure that a corresponding custom RequestMappingHandlerMapping and/or RequestMappingHandlerAdapter is defined as well - provided that you intend to use @RequestMapping.
items.translation: 注意：只有当调度器中存在相应的 HandlerMapping（用于类型级别注解）和/或 HandlerAdapter（用于方法级别注解）时，才会处理 @RequestMapping 注解。默认情况下即如此。但是，如果您定义了自定义的 HandlerMappings 或 HandlerAdapters，那么您需要确保也定义了相应的自定义 RequestMappingHandlerMapping 和/或 RequestMappingHandlerAdapter——前提是您打算使用 @RequestMapping。

items.source: Calling FrameworkServlet.setContextClass(Class) (init-param 'contextClass') overrides the default XmlWebApplicationContext and allows for specifying an alternative class, such as AnnotationConfigWebApplicationContext.
items.translation: 调用 `FrameworkServlet.setContextClass(Class)`（init-param 'contextClass'）会覆盖默认的 `XmlWebApplicationContext`，并允许指定一个替代类，例如 `AnnotationConfigWebApplicationContext`。

items.source: Note: This method may return null if invoked prior to onRefresh(ApplicationContext).
items.translation: 注意： 如果在调用onRefresh(ApplicationContext)之前调用此方法，它可能会返回null。

items.source: A web application can define any number of DispatcherServlets. Each servlet will operate in its own namespace, loading its own application context with mappings, handlers, etc. Only the root application context as loaded by ContextLoaderListener, if any, will be shared.
items.translation: Web 应用程序可以定义任意数量的 DispatcherServlet。每个 servlet 都在其自己的命名空间中运行，加载包含映射、处理器等的自身应用程序上下文。只有由 ContextLoaderListener（如果有）加载的根应用程序上下文会被共享。

items.source: DispatcherServlet may be injected with a web application context, rather than creating its own internally. This is useful in Servlet 3.0+ environments, which support programmatic registration of servlet instances. See the DispatcherServlet(WebApplicationContext) javadoc for details.
items.translation: DispatcherServlet 可以被注入 Web 应用程序上下文，而不是在内部自行创建。这在支持 Servlet 实例程序化注册的 Servlet 3.0+ 环境中非常有用。有关详细信息，请参阅 DispatcherServlet(WebApplicationContext) 的 JavaDoc。

items.source: Calling FrameworkServlet.setContextConfigLocation(String) (init-param 'contextConfigLocation') will dictate which XML files will be loaded by the default XmlWebApplicationContext
items.translation: 调用 FrameworkServlet.setContextConfigLocation(String)（init-param 'contextConfigLocation'）将决定由default XmlWebApplicationContext加载哪些 XML 文件。

items.source: Calling FrameworkServlet.setContextInitializerClasses(String) (init-param 'contextInitializerClasses') indicates which ApplicationContextInitializer classes should be used to further configure the internal application context prior to refresh().
items.translation: 调用 `FrameworkServlet.setContextInitializerClasses(String)`（init-param 'contextInitializerClasses'）可指定应使用哪些 `ApplicationContextInitializer` 类，以便在 `refresh()` 之前进一步配置内部应用程序上下文。

items.translation: 默认实现使用 AutowireCapableBeanFactory.createBean(Class)。

items.source:
This servlet is very flexible: It can be used with just about any workflow, with the
installation of the appropriate adapter classes. It offers the following functionality
that distinguishes it from other request-driven web MVC frameworks:
items.translation: 此 Servlet 非常灵活：通过安装相应的适配器类，它可以用于几乎任何工作流。它提供以下功能，使其区别于其他基于请求的 Web MVC 框架：

items.source:
Using this constructor indicates that the following properties / init-params
will be ignored:
items.translation: 使用此构造函数将忽略以下属性/初始化参数：

items.source:
Default is "true". Turn this off if you want this servlet to use a single
HandlerMapping, despite multiple HandlerMapping beans being defined in the context.
items.translation: 默认为"true"。如果希望此 Servlet 使用单个 HandlerMapping，即使上下文中定义了多个 HandlerMapping Bean，请将其关闭。

items.source:
Default is "true". Turn this off if you want this servlet to use a single
HandlerAdapter, despite multiple HandlerAdapter beans being defined in the context.
items.translation: 默认为"true"。如果希望此 Servlet 使用单个 HandlerAdapter，即使上下文中定义了多个 HandlerAdapter Bean，请将其关闭。

items.source:
Default is "true". Turn this off if you want this servlet to use a single
HandlerExceptionResolver, despite multiple HandlerExceptionResolver beans being defined in the context.
items.translation: 默认值为"true"。如果希望此 Servlet 使用单个 HandlerExceptionResolver，即使上下文中定义了多个 HandlerExceptionResolver Bean，请将其关闭。

items.source:
Default is "true". Turn this off if you want this servlet to use a single
ViewResolver, despite multiple ViewResolver beans being defined in the context.
items.translation: 默认为"true"。如果希望此 Servlet 使用单个 ViewResolver，即使上下文中定义了多个 ViewResolver Bean，请将其关闭。

items.source:
Default is "true", which is strongly recommended. Views should not rely on request attributes
having been set by (dynamic) includes. This allows JSP views rendered by an included controller
to use any model attributes, even with the same names as in the main JSP, without causing side
effects. Only turn this off for special needs, for example to deliberately allow main JSPs to
access attributes from JSP views rendered by an included controller.
items.translation: 默认值为 "true"，强烈建议启用。视图不应依赖于请求属性已被（动态）包含设置。这使得由包含控制器渲染的 JSP 视图能够使用任何模型属性，即使其名称与主 JSP 中的相同，也不会产生副作用。仅在特殊需求下才将其关闭，例如为了故意允许主 JSP 访问由包含控制器渲染的 JSP 视图的属性。

items.source: May be overridden in subclasses in order to initialize further strategy objects.
items.translation: 可在子类中重写以初始化更多策略对象。

items.source:
The default implementation uses the "DispatcherServlet.properties" file (in the same
package as the DispatcherServlet class) to determine the class names. It instantiates
the strategy objects through the context's BeanFactory.
items.translation: 默认实现使用与 `DispatcherServlet` 类位于同一包中的 `"DispatcherServlet.properties"` 文件来确定类名。它通过上下文的 `BeanFactory` 实例化策略对象。

items.source:
The handler will be obtained by applying the servlet's HandlerMappings in order.
The HandlerAdapter will be obtained by querying the servlet's installed HandlerAdapters
to find the first that supports the handler class.
items.translation:
处理器将通过按顺序应用 Servlet 的 HandlerMappings 来获取。
HandlerAdapter 将通过查询 Servlet 已安装的 HandlerAdapters 来获取，以找到第一个支持该处理器类的适配器。

items.source:
All HTTP methods are handled by this method. It's up to HandlerAdapters or handlers
themselves to decide which methods are acceptable.
items.translation: 所有 HTTP 方法均由此方法处理。由 HandlerAdapters 或处理器本身决定哪些方法是可接受的。

items.translation: 默认实现使用 Dispatcher 的 LocaleResolver 获取当前区域设置，该区域设置在请求期间可能会发生变化。

items.source:
Request attribute to hold the current web application context.
Otherwise only the global web app context is obtainable by tags etc.
items.translation: 请求属性用于保存当前 Web 应用程序上下文。否则，标签等组件只能获取全局 Web 应用程序上下文。

items.source: It can use any HandlerAdapter; this allows for using any handler interface. Default adapters are HttpRequestHandlerAdapter, SimpleControllerHandlerAdapter, for Spring's HttpRequestHandler and Controller interfaces, respectively. A default RequestMappingHandlerAdapter will be registered as well. HandlerAdapter objects can be added as beans in the application context, overriding the default HandlerAdapters. Like HandlerMappings, HandlerAdapters can be given any bean name (they are tested by type).
items.translation: 它可以使用任何 `HandlerAdapter`；这允许使用任何处理器接口。默认适配器是 `HttpRequestHandlerAdapter` 和 `SimpleControllerHandlerAdapter`，分别用于 Spring 的 `HttpRequestHandler` 和 `Controller` 接口。此外，还会注册一个默认的 `RequestMappingHandlerAdapter`。可以在应用程序上下文中将 HandlerAdapter 对象添加为 bean，以覆盖默认的 HandlerAdapters。与 HandlerMappings 一样，HandlerAdapters 可以指定任何 bean 名称（它们按类型进行测试）。

items.source: The dispatcher's exception resolution strategy can be specified via a HandlerExceptionResolver, for example mapping certain exceptions to error pages. Default are ExceptionHandlerExceptionResolver, ResponseStatusExceptionResolver, and DefaultHandlerExceptionResolver. These HandlerExceptionResolvers can be overridden through the application context. HandlerExceptionResolver can be given any bean name (they are tested by type).
items.translation: Dispatcher 的异常解析策略可以通过一个 `HandlerExceptionResolver` 来指定，例如将某些异常映射到错误页面。默认包括 `ExceptionHandlerExceptionResolver`、`ResponseStatusExceptionResolver` 和 `DefaultHandlerExceptionResolver`。这些 `HandlerExceptionResolver` 可以通过应用程序上下文进行覆盖。`HandlerExceptionResolver` 可以指定任何 Bean 名称（它们按类型进行测试）。

items.source: It can use any HandlerMapping implementation - pre-built or provided as part of an application - to control the routing of requests to handler objects. Default is BeanNameUrlHandlerMapping and RequestMappingHandlerMapping. HandlerMapping objects can be defined as beans in the servlet's application context, implementing the HandlerMapping interface, overriding the default HandlerMapping if present. HandlerMappings can be given any bean name (they are tested by type).
items.translation: 它可以利用任何 `HandlerMapping` 实现——无论是预构建的还是作为应用程序的一部分提供——来控制将请求路由到处理对象。默认值为 `BeanNameUrlHandlerMapping` 和 `RequestMappingHandlerMapping`。`HandlerMapping` 对象可以定义为 servlet 应用程序上下文中的 bean，实现 `HandlerMapping` 接口；如果存在默认 `HandlerMapping`，则对其进行覆盖。`HandlerMappings` 可以赋予任意 bean 名称（它们按类型进行测试）。

items.source: If a View or view name is not supplied by the user, then the configured RequestToViewNameTranslator will translate the current request into a view name. The corresponding bean name is "viewNameTranslator"; the default is DefaultRequestToViewNameTranslator.
items.translation: 如果用户未提供 View 或视图名称，则配置的 RequestToViewNameTranslator 将把当前请求转换为视图名称。对应的 Bean 名称为 "viewNameTranslator"；默认值为 DefaultRequestToViewNameTranslator。

items.source: Its view resolution strategy can be specified via a ViewResolver implementation, resolving symbolic view names into View objects. Default is InternalResourceViewResolver. ViewResolver objects can be added as beans in the application context, overriding the default ViewResolver. ViewResolvers can be given any bean name (they are tested by type).
items.translation: 其视图解析策略可以通过 `ViewResolver` 实现来指定，该实现将符号化视图名称解析为 View 对象。默认值为 `InternalResourceViewResolver`。ViewResolver 对象可以作为 bean 添加到应用程序上下文中，以覆盖默认的 ViewResolver。ViewResolvers 可以赋予任意 bean 名称（它们按类型进行测试）。

items.source: Its locale resolution strategy is determined by a LocaleResolver. Out-of-the-box implementations work via HTTP accept header, cookie, or session. The LocaleResolver bean name is "localeResolver"; default is AcceptHeaderLocaleResolver.
items.translation: 其区域设置解析策略由 LocaleResolver 决定。开箱即用的实现通过 HTTP 接受头、cookie 或会话进行工作。LocaleResolver Bean 的名称为 "localeResolver"；默认值为 AcceptHeaderLocaleResolver。

items.translation: 本命名空间中 Bean 工厂里 HandlerExceptionResolver 对象的知名名称。

items.source: Well-known name for the HandlerMapping object in the bean factory for this namespace.
items.translation: 该命名空间中 Bean 工厂里 HandlerMapping 对象的知名名称。

items.source: Well-known name for the ViewResolver object in the bean factory for this namespace.
items.translation: 该命名空间中 Bean 工厂里 ViewResolver 对象的知名名称。

items.source: Request attribute to hold the current web application context.
items.translation: 用于保存当前 Web 应用程序上下文的请求属性。

items.source: Build a LocaleContext for the given request, exposing the request's primary locale as current locale.
items.translation: 为给定的请求构建一个 LocaleContext，将请求的主要区域设置暴露为当前区域设置。

items.source: Convert the request into a multipart request, and make multipart resolver available.
items.translation: 将请求转换为多部分请求，并使多部分解析器可用。

items.source: Create a default strategy.
items.translation: 创建默认策略。

items.source: Process the actual dispatching to the handler.
items.translation: 处理实际的分发至处理器。

items.source: Create a List of default strategy objects for the given strategy interface.
items.translation: 为给定的策略接口创建默认策略对象列表。

items.source: Return the default strategy object for the given strategy interface.
items.translation: 返回给定策略接口的默认策略对象。

items.source: Return the HandlerExecutionChain for this request.
items.translation: 返回此请求的 HandlerExecutionChain。

items.source: Initialize the strategy objects that this servlet uses.
items.translation: 初始化此 servlet 使用的策略对象。

items.source: Render the given ModelAndView.
items.translation: 渲染给定的 ModelAndView。

items.source: Resolve the given view name into a View object (to be rendered).
items.translation: 将给定的视图名称解析为要渲染的 View 对象。

items.source:
Set whether to perform cleanup of request attributes after an include request, that is,
whether to reset the original state of all request attributes after the DispatcherServlet
has processed within an include request.
items.translation: 设置是否在包含请求后清理请求属性，即在 DispatcherServlet 在包含请求中处理后，是否重置所有请求属性的原始状态。

items.source: Set whether to detect all HandlerAdapter beans in this servlet's context.
items.translation: 设置是否检测此 Servlet 上下文中的所有 HandlerAdapter Bean。

items.source: Set whether to detect all HandlerExceptionResolver beans in this servlet's context.
items.translation: 设置是否检测此 Servlet 上下文中所有的 HandlerExceptionResolver Bean。

items.source: Set whether to detect all HandlerMapping beans in this servlet's context.
items.translation: 设置是否检测此 Servlet 上下文中的所有 HandlerMapping Bean。

items.source: Set whether to detect all ViewResolver beans in this servlet's context.
items.translation: 设置是否检测此 Servlet 上下文中的所有 ViewResolver Bean。

items.source: ServletContext and ServletConfig objects will be delegated to the application context
items.translation: ServletContext 和 ServletConfig 对象将被委托给应用程序上下文。

items.source: Exception - if the view cannot be resolved (typically in case of problems creating an actual View object)
items.translation: Exception - 如果视图无法解析（通常在创建实际的 View 对象时出现问题）

items.source: If the given context has not already been assigned an id, one will be assigned to it
items.translation: 如果给定的上下文尚未分配 `id`，则为其分配一个。

items.source: ex - the exception that got thrown during handler execution
items.translation: ex - 在处理器执行期间抛出的异常

items.source: viewName - the name of the view to resolve
items.translation: viewName - 要解析的视图名称

items.source: locale - the current locale
items.translation: locale - 当前区域设置

items.source: Field Details
items.translation: 字段详情
